{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in flipper_length_mm
print("Missing values in flipper_length_mm:", df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Compute mean flipper length by species, which automatically excludes missing values
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the full result to capture exact values
print("Mean flipper length by species:")
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify the species with the highest mean
highest_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_species}")"}
